def transform(grid):
    sep=len(grid)//2
    if len(set(grid[sep])) != 1:
        raise ValueError('missing center divider')
    top,bottom=grid[:sep],grid[sep+1:]
    common=set(v for row in top for v in row) & set(v for row in bottom for v in row)
    if len(common)!=1:
        raise ValueError(f'expected one color shared by both panels, got {common}')
    shared=next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if top[r][c]==shared and bottom[r][c]==shared else shared for c in range(len(top[0]))] for r in range(len(top))]
